open_points.subject: flow:service_start missing-setting outcome
open_points.text: “a missing setting ... ends the start” contradicts “an optional one that is absent takes its default” and “the default of each optional setting”
open_points.question: Does an absent optional setting take its A8 default, or does every absent setting end the start?
options: Only an absent required setting ends the start; an absent optional setting takes its default.
Every absent setting, including an optional one, ends the start.
open_points.default_guess: Only an absent required setting ends the start; an absent optional setting takes its A8 default.

witness.initial: The environment contains every required setting but omits PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT.
outcomes: runtime_settings supplies port 8850 and the service can continue starting.
The missing port setting ends the start without the service listening.

open_points.subject: runtime_settings validation of unacceptable values
open_points.text: “the refusal of a missing required setting or of a value of the wrong form”
open_points.question: Which module and capability reject values that have the right form but violate A8, particularly a whole-number port outside 1–65535 or a string naming an unknown time zone?
options: capability:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings rejects these values as part of runtime-settings validation.
capability:deliverer_service.load_config rejects them after runtime_settings returns them.
Another named capability rejects them before the server is started.
open_points.default_guess: capability:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings rejects them as part of runtime-settings validation.

witness.initial: All required environment variables are present, the timezone is known, and PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is 0, which is an integer but outside A8's permitted range.
events: capability:deliverer_service.load_config receives the resulting settings if loading succeeds.
capability:deliverer_service.run_service attempts to serve on the settings' port.
outcomes: runtime_settings treats the range violation as its validation responsibility and ends the start.
runtime_settings treats 0 as having the required integer form; no named later operation owns the A8 range check, so the server may bind an ephemeral port and listen.
